LOW_HouseOfHope_Skeleton_Debtor
Morfred, or Infernal Mason, is one of many infernal debtors stuck at the House of Hope after making a deal with  Raphael.[3] He can be found cleaning and generally pottering around the House's feast hall.

The party can ask the Mason for information about the House, but he will give only vague answers in reply. He will, however, reveal that he is the architect of Moonrise Towers, and the party will have the opportunity to tell him the state of his creation and the surrounding shadow-cursed lands.

“
I was an architect in life, a builder of tombs and temples, but mostly of towers. My proudest work reached for the stars and sought to dry Selûne's tears.
„
— Infernal Mason when asked about his background

History

Before the Shadow-Cursed Lands were overcome by Shar's curse, the Infernal Mason was a Selûnite named Morfred.[4][5] Morfred worked at Reithwin Town's mason guild, under his master the great general  Ketheric Thorm.

The town was originally home to many Selûnites, including Ketheric and his family. It was the Mason who was the original architect of Moonrise Towers, a grand symbol of devotion to Selûne.[6]

After the death of his daughter, Ketheric turned to Shar and built up an army of Dark Justiciars. Morfred witnessed Ketheric's descent, growing his army and rooting out every last trace of Selûne in Reithwin, until eventually Morfred and his brother Halfred were the last remaining Selûnite leaders in the town, joined by worshippers in secret.[7]

Tired of standing by as Ketheric and his Justiciars overtook the town, Morfred's despair caught the attention of  Raphael, who took notice and approached him with an infernal pact: his soul in exchange for the Justiciars complete destruction.[8][9]

Raphael honoured his deal by sending  Yurgir and his merregons, who slaughtered all but one Justiciar. Without his army, and routed by the Harpers, Ketheric released the Shadow Curse in a final act of desperation.

Morfred died some time later and became a debtor, bound to the House of Hope.

Involvement

Act Two

If the party loot a Dark Justiciar's corpse in the Ruined Battlefield, they can discover the beginnings of an ⁠investigation into a Selûnite resistance that had occurred during the Justiciar's occupation years ago.

The note on the corpse directs the party to a potter's workshop; one of the Selûnite holdouts. At the house is another note, documenting another holdout under the Last Light Inn. In the inn's cellar, a small shrine to Selûne keeps a  Halfred's Note, a letter from Morfred's brother Halfred, writing how Morfred was gathering a network of allies against Ketheric Thorm, and pointing to the Mason's Guild as another holdout.

The final point of investigation takes the party through a hatch in the Mason's Guild to the basement. All that remains are the shadowed remnants of Morfred's resistance, and the  Mason's Log. Morfred's log documents Ketheric's downfall, the rise of his army, and Morfred's final attempt to stop him by making a deal with  Raphael.
